release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.8 - Registration & Admin Panel Enhancements:
- Added Display Name and Phone Number fields to all registration screens
- Display Name and Phone Number are now stored in database
- Admin can now change user display names from admin panel
- Fixed logs screen - Added backend endpoints for user and admin logs
- Logs screen now properly displays activity logs
- Improved user management in admin panel
- Enhanced data consistency across all platforms
